title: Declaration record
description: A declaration, prototype, struct/enum body or quoted code block, exactly as one corpus page prints it. knowledge/kb/declarations.jsonl(.gz).

entity.description: Canonical entity id, or null when the page is not an API page.

kind.description: DERIVED from the text (typedef struct -> struct, ...). null when the text does not say.

role.description: syntax: the page's Syntax/Declaration block for the entity. example: a code block quoted in the prose.

language.description: DERIVED from the layer the page belongs to: 'c' for the CE and Win32 trees, 'managed' for corpus/dotnet (C#/VB/C++/JScript signatures; those records are written to kb/declarations-dotnet.jsonl, not the C declaration file).

spacing.description: DERIVED heuristic on the text itself. collapsed: the page lost the spaces between tokens (HANDLECreateFile()); the same API's declaration from another source may be intact. The text is never repaired.

text.description: The declaration verbatim, whitespace and all.

members.description: For struct/union/enum bodies: the member lines, quoted as they appear.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the page this record quotes.
